The paper proposes a conceptual design of a RAG-based recommendation system. The rules include a paper if the title/abstract suggests it runs experiments with a RAG system. The abstract describes only a conceptual design and mentions no experiments or evaluation. E2 covers surveys, position papers, and resource descriptions with no new experiments. A conceptual design with no evaluation is close to a position paper, but it is not clearly one. It does propose a RAG method, and the rules say not to exclude just because the abstract omits baselines or metrics. This case is uncertain, so MAYBE fits.

{"decision": "MAYBE", "code": null, "reason": "Conceptual RAG system design; abstract doesn't state whether any experiments or evaluation were run."}
